answer: Anchor trust in old growth: an account's weight grows like a cedar, a fraction of its confirmed history per epoch, so no fresh identity can outbid ten seasons of verified work. Each round an audit ripples outward from randomly chosen nodes, a falcon pass that checks whether cited partners exist and co-signed real tasks; any account caught pointing at phantom peers loses its whole canopy at once. Sybils can mint identities but not age, and they cannot answer an audit they never had work to show for.
